pr_title: Add a git tag to a pull request
pr_body:
Fixes #17914

This allows you to add an optional tag after the PR is merged.
Option in PR settings per repo, disabled by default

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1810977/167298764-458174cd-6e66-412b-a649-4a3b313d96a1.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1810977/162591192-53409fdb-ca54-4eda-bf72-f4d25ead5176.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1810977/162591219-e08d31ad-9805-4365-ba10-6c5e241bd703.png)
pr_comments: CI errors are related.

~I also can not reproduce this locally when running `go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@v1.44.2 run`~

Seems like a lot of changes landed in main that's causing it.
conflicts and errors fixed

Hmm... I'm not sure about this. I think this is a bit awkward and I don't think that many people are going to want to do this.

Since the cherry pick functionality was merged you can click on the SHA from the `pull request was merged as ...` and that will take you to a page where you can create a tag from the `Actions` menu.

I could perhaps see that it might be nice to have a link after the `pull request was merged as ...` that would allow you to create a tag there but I think overloading the merge message box seems a little over.

What's the reason behind creating an immediate tag?
Hmm... We've been able to create tags from within the Gitea UI for a while.

> Hmm... We've been able to create tags from within the Gitea UI for a while.

That's why I said: "or of course do it via gitea" :)
The problem is that it is manual work and that the CI is already building the job by the time you've added the tag.
How about to add a tag input box beside delete branch button in the same page after merged?

> How about to add a tag input box beside delete branch button in the same page after merged?

That's still an extra step that has to be done after the merge where theres a big chance the CI has already started before we've entered and submitted the tag.

The reason I put it where it is now is so that it's executed immediately after the merge. (just like the [x] delete branch check)
I was also looking for a way to make the textbox in the current implementation optional (as it's probably not useful for everyone), but I didn't find the right way in the templates to make it hidden when it's not active.
Maybe it could be added as an option in repository settings "Allow creating tag on Pull Request merge" that would be false by default?

@lafriks that's fine by me, I just need some help with the template to make it show/hide in `templates/repo/issue/view_content/comments.tmpl`. I've been looking in other templates but didn't find something that worked.
It should be similar to `{{if $prUnit.PullRequestsConfig.AllowMerge}}` as in the code above
`PullRequestsConfig` could be added now option something like `AllowCreateTag`

Yes you're right, sorry I was confusing it with something a previous implementation where I wanted it to be visible if the checkbox was checked.
I'll refactor it with that change later today.
Modified now with the suggestions and also added an extra screenshot
Before I again spend a few hours to rebase this on main as it looks like I now seem to learn Vue, can someone let me know if this PR has a change of being merged ? :)
Please resolve the conflicts.
@lunny conflicts resolved
Conflicts resolved again, can anyone take a look please ?
Please resolve the conflicts.
Conflicts resolved, ready for review

I do not think it's right to ask contributors to "please resolve conflicts" again and again.

Is there any consensus that whether this feature is accepted? If yes, review & merge soon, if not ....... close?
It has been stale for a long time and I can't think of a way to handling it other than closing it. Feel free to reopen if there's any new progress and I could also help.

issue_context.title: Add an option to add a git tag to a Pull Request when merging
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Add an option to add a git tag to a Pull Request. 
After merging the PR this tag will be automatically added.
Useful for hotfixes, releases etc .. :)

### Screenshots

_No response_
comments: This sounds like something CI could do, no?
Any pointers how you would your CI (eg Jenkins) (easily) do this ? Most of the time CI reacts on a tag and doesn't know when to set a tag?
Ah, sorry, my mind was thinking labels. Do you mean a git tag?
@jolheiser yes, I've updated the title now to make it more clear.

review_comments: Maybe it's better to have the transaction with creating Tag.
I'm already using transactions here though?

Because we can have a  adding a tag at the same time as deleting the branch. We should output both messages if both are selected.

The `if form.DeleteBranchAfterMerge` on line 1095 which calls this `deleteBranch` method is run after the `if form.TagAfterMerge` on line 1065
why do we need a new comment?, normal tagging does not create a commit

@6543 this is an action like a merge, so that it's visible in the timeline that the tag has been set by gitea. Like we also show branch deletes. See also screenshot above where it says "wim added tag xxx to yyy"

Fine for me to remove it though.
I think reuse the `Content` is enough.
would be better to precheck if can create tag before merge.
